text: This report presents a revision to the Toronto Green Standard Version 4 (TGS v4) 2022 embodied emissions performance measures and information on the Toronto Green Standard Communication Strategy. The proposed revision is in response to a July 2021 Council request to provide an update on the outcome of the 2022 study work on embodied emissions and opportunities to improve the uptake of higher levels of performance through the Toronto Green Standard. The revision to the Toronto Green Standard would further advance net zero emissions in new development through the incorporation of embodied emissions caps and is a critical component of the City's efforts to achieve zero emissions buildings by 2030 as set out in TransformTO.
